subject: Vendor onboarding: Solarix — VAT evidence, e-invoice and PO activation
messages:
From: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@solarix.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Julia Martens <j.martens@solarix.co>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 14:15:00 +01:00
Subject: Vendor setup: Solarix (EU) - VAT IDs and e-invoice capability

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Per our discussion, attaching our VAT registration certificate and a short matrix of our e-invoicing capabilities (attached: solarix_tax_certificate.pdf, solarix_einvoice_capabilities.xlsx).

Key details:
- Legal name: Solarix Renewables S.A.
- Billing address: Rue de l'Energie 7, 1000 Brussels, BE
- VAT (EU) ID: BE0123456789
- Bank (IBAN): BE91 0961 2345 6789

We are a Belgium-headquartered supplier and will be invoicing Redwood from our EU entity. For EU customers, most of our work is cross-border B2B and we expect reverse-charge treatment to apply. We can include the standard reverse-charge clause and our VAT on the invoice.

Request: please confirm the PO activation steps and whether Redwood needs any additional vendor evidence to enable reverse-charge and to accept our e-invoices. We can produce an official VAT registration extract and an AP contact if helpful.

Also note: we can deliver invoices in PDF and ZUGFeRD/UBL XML if preferred — details in the attached spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Carlos Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
Solarix Renewables
c.ruiz@solarix.co | +32 2 555 0123

Attachments: solarix_tax_certificate.pdf, solarix_einvoice_capabilities.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@solarix.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Julia Martens <j.martens@solarix.co>
Date: Fri, 23 Jan 2026 09:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: Solarix (EU) - VAT IDs and e-invoice capability

Carlos — thanks and welcome.

Quick checklist from procurement so we can move to PO activation:
1) Official VAT extract (government PDF) or national registry link showing BE0123456789 (if possible).
2) Company legal name exactly as it should appear on PO/invoice.
3) Confirmation of invoice remit email and invoice format (PDF or XML+PDF).
4) Bank details for PO/payments (IBAN + SWIFT).

Cc'ing Ben (Finance) to confirm Redwood invoice header requirements and whether AP needs any additional tax forms for reverse-charge. Ben — can you advise if we need a fiscal rep attestation or any other EU-specific evidence for our system?

Once we have those, procurement will issue a PO and attach the PO PDF to the vendor record; typically PO activation takes 2-3 business days. If Solarix needs a PO number prior to starting work we can prioritize.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@solarix.co>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jan 2026 11:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: Solarix (EU) - VAT IDs and e-invoice capability

Carlos / Vanessa — looping in AP and tax requirements from Redwood Finance.

Thanks for the attachments, Carlos — helpful. A few items from finance to enable PO + automated invoice processing:
- Please confirm the exact legal entity for invoicing (we need the full registered name and the BE VAT number to match our vendor record).
- On the invoice please include: PO number, Redwood billing entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.), Redwood VAT/Tax ID (we will provide the PO with the correct billing entity), invoice #, invoice date, service period, line-item descriptions, gross amount, and a line noting "Reverse charge — VAT accounted for by the recipient" (or similar depending on local phrasing).
- Invoice email for AP ingest: ap-eu@redwood.com. If you send structured invoices (UBL/XML) include the PDF payload also — our ingestion pipeline prefers PDF+machine-readable attachment.
- Bank details: IBAN + BIC required; payments are made via SEPA for EU vendors.

We do not generally require a fiscal representative for Belgian suppliers under standard cross-border B2B reverse charge, but we need a government-issued VAT extract showing the VAT number is active. If you are registered in a different EU member state for VAT, send the relevant extract.

I can expedite PO issuance once Vanessa confirms vendor record details. If Solarix needs a rate card or payment terms on the PO (30/45 days), let us know.

Ben Carter
Finance — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 26 Jan 2026 21:42:00 +00:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup: Solarix (EU) - VAT IDs and e-invoice capability

Carlos — thanks for the patience.

We have completed validation of the vendor evidence and issued PO 124558. Attached is the PO PDF (PO_124558.pdf). Next steps for Solarix:
1) Please send your first invoice referencing PO 124558 to ap-eu@redwood.com and include the PDF invoice plus any accompanying XML (if using e-invoice).
2) Invoice must include: Solarix Renewables S.A. (legal name), VAT: BE0123456789, PO 124558, and the phrase "Reverse charge — VAT accounted for by the recipient" (or equivalent text).
3) If invoice is split across Redwood legal entities, please confirm which Redwood billing entity is on the invoice (we will provide guidance on PO PDF if needed).
4) For faster payment, include your SEPA details and note payment terms (Net30 by default).

We have uploaded your vendor documents to the onboarding folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSolarixOnboarding. If you need the PO in a different format (CSV for AP system), tell us and we will provide it.

Welcome aboard — reach out if anything is unclear.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Accounts Payable | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
